video_title: Windy looks to Joel Embiid's health as a reason for LeBron to NOT GO to Philly 😳 | First Take

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James's free agency decision and contract value remain unclear
quotes.excerpt: It's not clear exactly what LeBron wants to get paid, something less than his value.
quotes.quote: It's not clear exactly what LeBron wants to get paid, something less than his value. Is it an exception? Is it the minimum? It's not clear what's driving him. He's been said to everybody that it's basketball happiness. What does that mean? It might mean something different today than it does a month from now or a year from now.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Bob Myers argues the 76ers offer LeBron the best chance to win
quotes.excerpt: Bob Myers is stating his case. He's saying, look, with this backcourt, Maxey and Edgecome.
quotes.quote: Bob Myers is stating his case. He's saying, look, with this backcourt, Maxey and Edgecome, you're not going to have to be on the ball as much. With Jaylen Brown, you're not going to have to work as hard defensively. The other team's best perimeter scorer, we're going to have covered. With Joel Embiid, you can take some possessions off. You're not going to have to score as much. In other words, we're going to offer you a minimum contract and not expect you to play like a max player.

quotes.speaker: Marcus Spears
quotes.summary_phrase: Marcus Spears questions the 76ers roster depth and continuity
quotes.excerpt: I don't think that's the Philadelphia 76ers. They look like a great idea.
quotes.quote: I don't think that's the Philadelphia 76ers. They look like a great idea. They look like a great concoction on NBA 2K even without LeBron James there, because I got a lot of questions about their roster. Who's going to do the little things? Who's going to do the things that don't show up in the box score? With Jaylen Brown added to that already, I covered that team in the playoffs in that second-round series against the New York Knicks where they got destroyed. And Tyrese Maxey looked out of sorts because Joel Embiid was out there. And Joel Embiid over the past two years has not played the equivalent of a full season in those two seasons. So if he's going to play 40 games because of what his body has done to him, how much can you develop any continuity? Who's going to be the person to do all the ugly stuff, all the defense, all the dirty work when you got four guys who demand the ball rightfully can say, I need the rock?

quotes.speaker: Marcus Spears
quotes.summary_phrase: Marcus Spears highlights Tyrese Maxey's development and role
quotes.excerpt: Tyrese Maxey is the guy. He's the guy that you've developed.
quotes.quote: Tyrese Maxey is the guy. He's the guy that you've developed. He's the guy that you have sort of built under from all the different coaches and all these different regimes and now you're going to tell him, hey, here's Jaylen Brown who had a quote-unquote MVP-like season last year where he took 36% of the possessions. That's more than Luka Doncic. Like that is a lot to control for one player. Then you add him and now you're going to say, let's add in LeBron James. I feel like that would be expecting a little too much.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Windhorst identifies Joel Embiid's health as the primary risk for Philly
quotes.excerpt: If you're countering Philly as a championship contender, you go to the reason why they haven't been able.
quotes.quote: If you're countering Philly as a championship contender, you go to the reason why they haven't been able to for the last decade and that's Joel Embiid's health. What you're saying to LeBron is, hey, listen, you may have to play big on this team. LeBron really got going last year when he was able to play in transition and that certainly is a selling point with Tyrese Maxey. But you'd have to say to LeBron, listen, what are you going to do when Joel Embiid gets hurt? When Joel Embiid gets hurt and then you're expected to play big because that's what happens on these teams when your centers are down. He had to play big last year when the Lakers dealt with issues with their center position. So that's the thing. Their ceiling is predicated on Joel Embiid's health as it has been for years.

quotes.speaker: Marcus Spears
quotes.summary_phrase: Marcus Spears and Brian Windhorst debate the viability of a Philly move
quotes.excerpt: You're talking about Philadelphia with Jaylen Brown and Tyrese Maxey and LeBron James going to Baltic Avenue.

text_blocks.speaker: Marcus Spears
text_blocks.text: You're talking about Philadelphia with Jaylen Brown and Tyrese Maxey and LeBron James going to Baltic Avenue and you're talking about Joel Embiid, unproven, injury risk, Joel Embiid as a better fit in the Western Conference with LeBron James and better chance to win a championship than the Philadelphia 76ers with three 25-point per game players?

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: The only thing Bob Myers can offer is that Joel Embiid is healthy today. That was what Bob was saying. Nobody knows about September, nobody knows about the spring. That's the problem.
